title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) will report its fourth quarter and full year 2025 earnings results on February 10, 2026, after the market closes. The Company’s earnings release and any supplemental information will be posted on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website – www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . InvenTrust will host an earnings conference call to discuss the Company’s results and business highlights on February 11, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website. Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Conference Call Date: Wednesday, February 11, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. ET Dial-In Number: 833-470-1428 Access Code: 220637 Webcast Replay Link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/470227160 About InvenTrust Properties Corp.
